items.title: Multi-KB Retrieval with Amazon Connect Customer AI Agents for Global Contact Centers
items.summary: How AcmePets unified disparate knowledge sources to deliver accurate, region-specific pet information to contact center agents worldwide Introduction AcmePets is a worldwide pet information service with global contact centers that helps callers from around the world access accurate information about pet care. A significant portion of their inquiry volume centers on vaccination requirements for cats […]
